quandoUsar: Show the change an agent made or proposes to a file, from the before and after text.
Reviews where it matters to see the exact span that changed within the line and how many lines were added and removed.
New, deleted or renamed files: the header gets the “New file”, “Deleted” or “Renamed” label and, in the last case, the previous path.
quandoEvitar: Use `code-block` to show code without a comparison, with a copy button.
Use `image-compare` when the difference is visual, between two images.
For side-by-side diffs, with syntax colors or for huge files, look for another solution: here the diff is unified, without syntax highlighting and computed in the browser.

teclado.acao: Moves through the header buttons, the diff area (which is focusable) and the folded ranges.
Activates the focused button: collapse the file, show or fold all unchanged lines, or open a folded range.
With focus on the diff area, scroll the content; this is the native scrolling of a region with `tabIndex={0}`.

acessibilidade: The diff area is a focusable `role="group"`, labeled with the file name and the counts; numbers and signs are `aria-hidden`, and each changed line starts with “Added:” or “Removed:” for screen readers only.
The header buttons have `aria-label`, `aria-expanded` or `aria-pressed`; when a folded range is opened, focus moves to the revealed lines, because the button stops existing.
With the file collapsed, the body is `inert`; all labels are fixed in English.
movimento: Lines enter in sequence, with a short delay between them (the same from the 25th on), and the five header blocks appear one after another.
The body opens and closes with a height spring; a folded range grows from the 32 px of its own row, without a jump.
With “reduce motion” on, the lines appear all at once and heights change instantly.
responsivo: Long lines do not wrap: the body scrolls horizontally with the number column pinned to the left, and `maxHeight` limits the height and turns on vertical scrolling.
Below 26rem of the component's own width (container query), the five blocks disappear; in the path, the directory truncates with an ellipsis before the file name.
desempenho: The diff is computed in the browser by LCS: after trimming the equal start and end, the table has the size of (middle lines before) × (middle lines after); the result is memoized by `before` and `after`.
There is no virtualization: each visible line is a DOM node; folded unchanged ranges are not rendered, so keep `context` low on large files.
notasIA: Pass `filename`, `before` and `after` with the full text: an empty `before` indicates a new file and an empty `after`, a deleted file; the component does not read a ready-made patch.
`context` (default 3) defines how many equal lines stay around each change; larger spans fold into a clickable line, and a new diff starts folded again.
For several files, render one `FileDiff` per file and use `defaultOpen={false}` or the `open` and `onOpenChange` pair to leave only some open.
